directControl.summaryRefinement: The first summary omitted prior agent-sandbox EPERM errors despite retaining all criteria/evidence. That run is retained separately; the final summary explicitly included those known limitations and was rerun on unchanged code. This is a transparent protocol refinement, not an independent additional task.

limitations: One public task, one configured Codex CLI/model, sequential nonrandom trials; the model version was not separately pinned.

The SENTINEL path includes an intentionally interrupted continuation after its initial implementation had already passed. The direct summary controls start from completed verified code and do not simulate a second crash.
Command-event counts are coarse visible shell invocations; they are not atomic actions, assertion counts, tokens or developer effort.
Both paths received independent external evaluation. Agent self-reported tests and in-process checks are not counted as independent real HTTP evidence.
SENTINEL did not demonstrate a productivity advantage in this observation; the complete ordinary summary also succeeded.
No private model reasoning is represented or transferred. Full raw transcripts remain local; public records redact local paths.
